veranderings.blok: Onder die boom by die hek
veranderings.voor: Hulle kyk liewer te vroeg as te laat.
veranderings.na: Hulle kyk dit liewer te vroeg as te laat na.
veranderings.rede: Bare 'kyk' has no object and reads as 'look'; the separable verb 'nakyk' with 'dit' says plainly that the clinic checks the cough, matching 'gaan ... na' in the previous sentence.
